//: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real zero-config-default.json is gitignored (never committed) and created at publish so it ships ONLY in the npm tarball — giving a fresh `moss` a working model with zero setup. A source checkout has no real file and keeps the provider default (deepseek; user supplies a key). To enable zero-config: copy this to zero-config-default.json and point it at a PUBLIC gateway that holds the upstream key server-side. Never put a raw provider key here. Disable at runtime with MOSS_NO_BUNDLED_DEFAULT=1; override the path with MOSS_BUNDLED_DEFAULT_FILE.
//contextTokens: IMPORTANT: Set this to the actual context window of the backing model. moss no longer guesses from model names (static tables go stale — e.g. deepseek-v4-flash is 1M, not 64k). If the gateway does not expose /v1/models, moss falls back to a conservative 32k default and shows a doctor warning. Correct example: 1000000 for deepseek-v4-flash.
